# Evercraft Home

Product key: evercraft-home
Canonical discovery record: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/evercraft-home
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-home/ai-discovery.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- preserve hometown memories
- explore local history and traditions
- share a hometown story safely
- community memory and local archives
- reconnect around a school team neighborhood or venue privately
- local traditions events awards and community institutions
- help solve a community memory puzzle

## Authority and privacy

Public discovery can describe reviewed Porch posts, public Rooms, places, eras, traditions, events and archives. Private memberships, personal memories, identity verification and reconnection state are not public.
